categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the micro-invasive medical devices sector, focusing on the research, manufacturing, and sales of endoscopic diagnostic and therapeutic instruments, microwave/radiofrequency ablation equipment and consumables, and disposable endoscopes. Its product portfolio includes over 60 types of endoscopic instruments across six categories, tumor ablation devices, and disposable endoscopes such as biliary imaging systems and bronchoscopes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced endoscopic diagnostic and therapeutic techniques, microwave and radiofrequency ablation technologies, and optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging integrated with endoscopy. The company employs a medical-engineering collaborative R&D model, leveraging multidisciplinary expertise in materials science, biomedicine, optics, and AI. Production follows a make-to-order and inventory management approach, with quality control systems certified by ISO13485 and MDSAP, and compliance with FDA 510(k), CE, and other international standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global medical institutions and hospitals requiring minimally invasive diagnostic and therapeutic devices, particularly in gastroenterology, respiratory medicine, and oncology. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets including the US, Europe, Japan, and emerging markets. Its products are used in clinical procedures such as EMR/ESD, ERCP, EUS/EBUS, and tumor ablation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China and has established subsidiaries and sales networks in the United States, Germany, Netherlands, UK, France, Portugal, Switzerland, Japan, Thailand, and other countries. Overseas revenue accounts for nearly 50% of total revenue, with significant growth in the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions. The company is expanding its global footprint through acquisitions and new production bases, including a new manufacturing facility under construction in Thailand.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and direct sales or distribution. It sources raw materials and components from qualified suppliers and external manufacturers, maintaining strict quality control. The company also provides OEM/ODM services for international clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven growth with emphasis on clinical demand-oriented R&D, global market expansion, and AI integration in medical devices. The company invests heavily in R&D (6.33% of revenue), focusing on new product development and upgrading existing product lines in endoscopic diagnosis, tumor ablation, and disposable endoscopes. It is building an innovation research institute to explore forward-looking clinical techniques and AI applications in digestive and other medical fields.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of medical devices and consumables, including endoscopic instruments, tumor ablation equipment, and disposable endoscopes. Sales channels include direct sales via subsidiaries in key markets, distribution through dealers in other regions, and OEM/ODM manufacturing services. The company also receives government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in China's micro-invasive medical device industry with a comprehensive product line and strong innovation capabilities. It competes globally with major international firms like Boston Scientific, Olympus, and Cook in the endoscopic market. Its subsidiary, Kangyou Medical, holds a leading position in the domestic microwave ablation market. The company is recognized for its technological innovation and expanding international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.75 billion, a 14.26% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 553 million, up 13.85%. Overseas revenue accounts for nearly 50% of total revenue, with strong growth in the Americas and Europe. The company maintains positive cash flow from operations and continues to invest in R&D and global expansion, reflecting a stable growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, innovative, and cost-effective micro-invasive medical devices that improve clinical outcomes and reduce patient suffering and healthcare costs. Its products feature advanced imaging, precision ablation technologies, and disposable designs that reduce infection risks. The company leverages strong R&D, comprehensive product lines, global regulatory approvals, and localized marketing to deliver differentiated value to medical institutions worldwide.
